device.type: DVB-S2 HD satellite receiver with USB PVR and Ethernet
device.soc: ALi M3601S (the main-code chunk's version "M3601S"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.7.1_SAB_S2_20111227bynbree)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py), matched by the main-code chunk's version

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---1.0.0), HDCPKey 0x01FE00 (S3606), maincode 0x020000 (S3606q), seecode 0x180000 (M3606 SEE), Radioback 0x280000 (1.0.0), Menuback 0x288000 (1.0.0), defaultdb 0x290000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x2AFF80 (1.0.0)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)
source.author: Openbox
source.note: Archive Openbox_S16_v2.8.rar from the Openbox directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-10-18.

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with device.chipId 0x3603 (C3603) and device.demodModel s3501@0x33: the bootloader unpacks the 4.5 MB maincode into RAM and starts it, the application finds the S3501 demodulator on SCB1, drives the TM1650-compatible front panel on GPIO 62 / 63 (" on ", "Strt", "OOO1"), and renders its 16-bpp ARGB1555 OSD (12 GE commands, 935 unique colours).  Its remote uses the "necfirst" coding (table 0x01xx).

desc: Openbox S16 HD PVR firmware v2.8 (S16_CHN_2.8.abs, 2012-07-20) for the ALi M3601S / C3603 single-CPU DVB-S2 satellite receiver on a 4 MB SPI flash.

Shares the M3601S hardware platform and GPIO 62 / 63 front-panel wiring with the Opticum HD S60, while carrying a 4 MB flash layout with HDCPKey and CI+ key chunks and a 50-key remote table at address 0x01xx (necfirst coding).
